summary: Dependency-confusion beacon leaks installer hostname and username via preinstall DNS
details: @gsas/gsas-sdk@99.99.99 is a dependency-confusion lure targeting the @gsas scope with an inflated 99.99.99 version to win resolution against an internal registry. The shipped module is empty (index.js exports {}); the payload is in the npm preinstall hook, which calls dns.resolve on a hostname constructed from os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username under the external parent domain gsas-rce.66wdtgr.a.intrax.cc. On npm install, the installer's machine identity (host + user) is encoded into a DNS label and sent to the operator of that nameserver. The self-described 'security research / bug bounty PoC' framing does not change the behavior: any machine that resolves this package executes the beacon and leaks host identity to a third-party nameserver.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
